info.title: Nestlancer Payments Service
info.description: The Nestlancer Payments Service API description

data.description: Business payload returned by the controller handler

type.description: The type of payment method being added

tokenId.description: Provider-specific token representing the saved payment method

last4.description: Last 4 digits of the card (for identification)

cardBrand.description: The card network brand (e.g., visa, mastercard)

walletProvider.description: The wallet service provider (e.g., paytm, phonepe)

nickname.description: User-defined friendly name for this payment method

setAsDefault.description: Whether to set this method as the default for future payments

platformAccountId.description: Platform settlement account used for the transfer

mediaIds.description: Media IDs of uploaded transfer proofs (image/PDF)

projectId.description: The unique ID of the project

milestoneId.description: The unique ID of the milestone (if applicable)

amount.description: The amount to be paid (in the smallest currency unit, e.g., paise for INR)

paymentMethodId.description: ID of a saved payment method to use

paymentIntentId.description: The payment intent or order ID from the payment provider

externalPaymentId.description: The external transaction ID from the payment provider

amount.description: Optional partial refund amount in the same unit as Payment.amount (paise for INR). If omitted, full refund is processed.

reason.description: Reason for the refund. Required for offline/manual/bank payments that have no Razorpay external id.

amount.description: Amount in paise (>= 1). When omitted, the billable milestone schedule amount is used. Never omit for zero-amount / delivery-only milestones.

clientId.description: Optional client id — must match the project owner when provided

method.description: Ignored — manual payments always use method=manual

paidAt.description: Optional paid-at timestamp (ISO 8601). Defaults to now.

allowRetry.description: If true, reset payment to CREATED so the client can retry (default true)
